description: Lybra distribution specification - declarative rules for distributing tools/credentials/config/charters to harness workstations. Per DESIGN v2 §4: distribution WHAT = data (this schema), distribution HOW = fixed primitives (distribute_tools.py engine). New distribution entry = add data row, zero code change. Replaces hardcoded ROLE_TOOL_MAPPING.

primitives.description: Fixed distribution primitives (implemented in distribute_tools.py engine). These are the ONLY operations; plugins/custom code forbidden per §4 design decision (supply-chain + auditability).

operations.name: copy_tree
operations.description: Recursively copy directory tree from source to target

operations.name: mint_credential
operations.description: Mint role credential via gate (enroll flow)

operations.name: render_charter
operations.description: AIPOS-F66B 件①: 章程 = 母本({{key}} 占位)+ 项目声明(project.json paths/repos, roles.schema write_boundary+hard_rules)→ 工位副本。唯一实现 tools/aipos_cli/charter_render.render_charter, sync(pull)与 distribute_tools(push)同用; 母本变/声明变即重渲染(manifest 记 source_sha256/render_context_sha256/rendered_sha256); 工位本地改动 = 声明缺口(覆盖前报 diff, 须回流母本或声明)。取代 charter 的 copy_tree+seed_only。

distributions.description: AIPOS-F73B件③: No-parameter /go command (pi extension). Single source for all roles, reads .lybra/role for instance identity.
distributions.notes: AIPOS-F73B: Single master go.ts extension. Queries product for claimed task by agent_instance (read from .lybra/role .instance), switches worktree, outputs startup report. Replaces dual bash scripts.

Filtered skill set per role requirements from roles.schema.json. AIPOS-F82 件①: finalize-slice 退出执行体分发(执行体零门, Owner 09-06: finalize 属产品, 执行体只写产物); 退役 = 从 include 删除, 共享落点 _distributed/skills/finalize-slice 由 sync prune 回收(无其他已 enroll 角色声明时)。
Advisor-specific skill set (AIPOS-R6E ⑥: card-author = 顾问出卡检查表; AIPOS-R6M 大项C②: truth-navigator = 时间线导航)

AIPOS-F66B 件①: seed_only 退役——章程 = 声明渲染物(母本 + 项目声明 → 工位副本), 母本变/声明变即重渲染, 工位本地改动 = 声明缺口(sync/distribute 报 diff 后覆盖, 须回流母本或声明)。目标工位按 .lybra/role 实例项目段过滤, 非本项目工位跳过。 Source of truth lives in lybra product repo (agents/roles/<class>/AGENTS.md).

distributions.description: Transitions schema for state machine navigation (AIPOS-CONN-LOOP-2 ③)
distributions.notes: Transitions schema 经 R3分发包下发到工位（生成物不入库）。连接器执行器从此schema读取转移规则，零特判。

git_commit_hash.description: Version equals source repo git commit hash (short form)

manifest_schema.description: Standard manifest written to target_root/.version-{role} after distribution. AIPOS-F66B: charter 条目 files[] 附三指纹(母本/声明/渲染物), 顶层 workstation 记工位归属(instance/project)。

gitignore_rules.description: Standard .gitignore entries for distributed artifacts (生成物不入库 per AIPOS-R3 lesson)
rules: AGENTS.md  # Charter is distributed, not committed
gitignore_rules.rationale: Distributed artifacts are derived from product repo. Committing them creates second source → inevitable drift. Single source = product repo; harness receives via distribution; version tracked in manifest.

extension_point.description: How to add a new distribution entry
steps: 1. Add entry to distributions[] array in this schema
2. Specify: distribution_id, kind, source, target, applies_to_roles, operation
3. Run distribute_tools.py - new entry takes effect immediately
4. Zero code change to distribute_tools.py engine (data-driven)
extension_point.forbidden: Custom code / plugins in distribute_tools.py. New primitive = product repo task + audit. Per §4: 'distribution WHAT = data, HOW = fixed engine'.

charter_render_semantics.description: AIPOS-F66B 件①: 章程渲染语义(取代 AIPOS-F27 seed_only_semantics; seed_only 属性退役, 残留声明不生效并出声)
charter_render_semantics.rule: kind=charter 的分发条目一律 operation=render_charter: 渲染物 = 母本正文({{project}}/{{governance_root}}/{{code_repo}}/{{return_root}}/{{verdict_root}}/{{queue_root}}/{{gate_url}}/{{harness_root}}/{{harness_parent}}/{{role}}/{{role_class}}/{{instance}} 占位按渲染上下文替换; 未声明占位 = 拒)+「项目声明」尾节 + 「写权限边界」节(roles.schema write_boundary 该角色行 + hard_rules)+ 渲染标记行(母本/声明指纹)。
charter_render_semantics.update_semantics: 母本 sha256 变 或 渲染上下文指纹变 → 重渲染覆盖; 工位副本 sha256 ≠ manifest 记录的 rendered_sha256 = 工位本地改动 = 声明缺口: 覆盖前输出 unified diff(工位本地 vs 渲染物), 改动须回流母本(产品仓一张卡)或声明(project.json / roles.schema), 不保留第二份真相; --force 与 charter 无关。
charter_render_semantics.single_implementation: tools/aipos_cli/charter_render.py (render_charter / charter_render_context / workstation_identity); 消费方 tools/aipos_cli/distribution_sync.py (apply_charter_render) 与 tools/distribute_tools.py (_primitive_render_charter)
charter_render_semantics.master_edit_note: 母本 agents/roles/<class>/AGENTS.md 中的项目专有字面(~/projects/lybra 等)改为占位属母本车道(agents/roles/), 本卡车道外, 登记待办; 渲染尾节已提供全部项目专有值, 母本无占位时渲染物 = 母本原文 + 尾节。

workstation_ownership_semantics.description: AIPOS-F66B 件① 硬前置: 任何分发条目的目标工位按其 .lybra/role 实例的项目段过滤(2026-09-05 chris hbj-coder 工位被写入 lybra 执行体章程的根治)
workstation_ownership_semantics.rule: 工位项目 = .lybra/role.instance 按 roles.schema naming.template 解析的 project 段(naming_profile.parse_instance_name 唯一解析)。sync 项目范围 = --project 显式 > --workspace-root 的 project.json project > 单工位缺省=工位自身项目; 多工位(--harness-root 给工位父根)必须显式范围, 禁猜。工位项目 ≠ 范围 → 跳过(零写入, 不连门)并在运行清单(<父根>/_distributed/.version-sync)与结果记 skipped; 推送侧 distribute_tools 同规则(另: .lybra/role.role ≠ 请求角色 = 拒)。

shared_landing_prune_semantics.description: AIPOS-F82 件①: 共享分发落点 prune 语义(2026-09-24 执行/审计工位 sync 互删乒乓的根治)
shared_landing_prune_semantics.rule: target_base=harness_parent 的分发物落在工位父根下, 其中 _distributed/ 为所有工位共享落点。sync 的 prune 集 = 落点上不在本角色声明的文件 − 共享落点下所有已 enroll 角色的声明并集。角色 = 工位父根下各工位 .lybra/role; 自定义角色经门注册表解析内建类(同 applies_to_roles_semantics); 每角色应得件按本 schema applies_to_roles 由 build_role_manifest 构建(与门同一构建器)。工位私有落点(.pi/extensions、AGENTS.md)不受并集影响。
shared_landing_prune_semantics.fail_closed: 任一工位身份/类/声明不可解析 = 并集不完整 → 共享落点 prune 暂停(不删, 逐条点名), 禁猜。
shared_landing_prune_semantics.steady_state: 任意顺序反复 sync 各工位后, 各工位 dry-run 的 plan 与 would_prune 皆空; 退役某角色的件 = 从该角色条目删除, 无其他角色声明时由 prune 回收。

applies_to_roles_semantics.description: AIPOS-F26 大项C: applies_to_roles 匹配语义 — 内建角色名直接匹配, 自定义角色按其注册表 class 展开匹配
applies_to_roles_semantics.rule: applies_to_roles 数组中只写内建角色名(如 executor, auditor)。构建器(build_role_manifest)在匹配时自动解析自定义角色的 class: 若自定义角色 hbj-coder 的 class=executor, 则 applies_to_roles=["executor"] 的分发物自动包含 hbj-coder。
applies_to_roles_semantics.forbidden: class: 前缀语法已删除(AIPOS-F26)。applies_to_roles 中禁止出现 class:executor 等写法——直接在构建器中按注册表 class 展开。

example.matches_for_custom: hbj-coder (class=executor in project.json) → 构建器解析 class → 匹配 executor → 自动包含

minimum_bootable_set.description: AIPOS-F54: workstation minimum bootable set — every item enroll must land in one action so a fresh workstation can start pi and run /lybra on with ZERO manual editing. Single source for the missing-item check (each missing item named individually; never 'one missing key breaks everything with no name'). Seeded seed_only: existing files are never overwritten (user customization preserved). Declared here per card acceptance #15 ('config.schema 或分发清单择一').

items.name: .lybra/connection.json
items.description: Gate connection + credentials + workspace_root + lybra_bin + governance_root

items.name: .lybra/role
items.description: Role identity incl. owner_policy_ref (derived from the effective owner_autonomy_policy envelope)

items.name: connection.json#lybra_bin
items.description: Points at the actual CLI deployment so /lybra sync works without probing (dangling path = missing; the TS resolver then probes and reports)

items.name: role#owner_policy_ref
items.description: Effective owner_autonomy_policy id — without it the loop cannot start (identity resolution fails)

items.name: AGENTS.md
items.description: AIPOS-F82 件②: charter seeded as the charter_render render (same renderer + render context as sync; no {{placeholders}}); existing file never overwritten (overwrite belongs to sync); render failure = not written + enroll warnings (never a raw master copy)

items.name: .pi/settings.json
items.description: Minimal pi settings (defaultProvider/enableSkillCommands/skills; NO defaultModel, NO extensions array)

items.name: .pi/extensions/claim.ts
items.description: Claim extension mount — relative symlink to ../../../_shared/extensions/claim.ts (AIPOS-F82: written only when the target exists; otherwise not written + enroll warnings, never a dangling mount)

items.name: .pi/skills/
items.description: Per-skill relative symlinks to ../../../_distributed/skills/<name>, allocated by role_class from this schema's kind=skills distributions (AIPOS-F82; roles.schema tool_package items not declared here = retired, not wired, named in enroll warnings)
